page.overview:
Who is Velgearian?

Velgearians are a race of artificial extraterrestrial lifeforms in Yu-Gi-Oh! GO RUSH!!. They were created by The Creator and by their progenitor, Kuaidul Velgear as "Kartoumata", autonomous pawns, or in Kuaidul' words, cards that could think. They came to dwell in the Velgearian Star Cluster. During the first season of the series, they were locked in war with an unknown enemy force but the specifics weren’t detailed.

In the second season, it is revealed by Kuaidal that the Velgearians are doomed to expire and vanish at the end of their lifespans. Although all of them (except for Yudias Velgear) vanish by the end of the season, they are eventually all revived via the properties of Damamu and the Dark Matter Space following Yudias’ Duel against Yuhi Ohdo in his ”Otes” persona. In the end of the series, the Velgearians choose to remain in the Sengoku period to ensure the safety of the future.

Velgearians resemble humans but have crescent-shaped highlights in their eyes. Some Velgearians also have red marks beneath their eyes of varying shapes. This form is described as their "Galaxy Form". It is initially claimed that Velgearians can live for eternity, being reformed by The Relic when they die. This is later proven to be false and Velgearians have an unspecified but finite lifespan where The Relic will no longer revive them. However, even then, they can be revived by other means like Dark Matter energy. If a Velgearian loses energy, they may be turned into a shirt form where they can be revitalized. If a Velgearian dies, they dissolve into particles of light. As implied with Yudias in the series finale, Velgearians may naturally become flat over time as they age and lose energy over long periods of time but otherwise do not visibly age like other lifeforms.

Velgearian soldiers generally dress uniformly in ash-white coats, sand-blue pants and grey armored boots. They prominently wear ash-white helmets that peak in the shape of cat ears with dark visors that conceal their eyes and leave their mouths exposed. Officers wear orange instead of blue, while Zuwijo Zwil Velgear's troops wear black versions of the standard uniform. Higher-ranking Velgearians wear custom outfits. All Velgearian soldiers are armed with energy swords that are holstered at their hips at dagger length, but can extend during combat, and with Gavil Chargers, which are more elaborate among higher-ranking Velgearians.
